CustomField.description: API name of the autolaunched orchestration Flow that runs first when a submission converts, coordinating the per-object conversion steps. The conversion platform-event handler resolves and invokes it; the per-object FlowApiName_* fields name the downstream Flows it (or the convert pipeline) calls. Blank uses the package default controller.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Advanced: API name of the master Flow that orchestrates conversion of a submission into records. Leave blank to use the package's default conversion controller.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName (Controller)
